author: jag-k

capabilities.reason: Fetch resource titles and project names from configured GitLab instances.

description: Rewrites copied GitLab project, planning, CI/CD, and repository URLs into Markdown links. With a configured instance token and an http grant it fetches resource titles and project names.
instructions: Use dev.jag-k.gitlab/project for project roots and static pages; use mr, issue, milestone, pipeline, job, commit, and tag for individual resources; use repository for tree, blob, raw, blame, commits, and compare URLs. MR and issue rules accept comment_display: hidden, marker, id, author, or author-and-id. Set online: false to force offline labels.
name: GitLab Links

rules.description: Turns a copied GitLab project URL into a Markdown link. Configurable aliases also match exact project pages such as merge_requests and pipelines; online mode adds the project name when available.
rules.name: GitLab project

aliases.description: Exact paths below `/-/` and their display labels. Paths may contain multiple segments, for example `wikis/home`. The rule also always matches the bare project URL. Replace this map to select or add pages.

hosts.description: GitLab hosts this rule matches. Defaults to the configured instance hosts, or `gitlab.com` when no instances are configured.

online.description: Fetch the project name when a configured instance and HTTP grant are available. Disable for deterministic offline labels.

rules.description: Turns a copied GitLab merge request URL into a Markdown link; with online mode, a configured instance, and an HTTP grant, the real title is included.
rules.name: GitLab merge request

CommentDisplay.description: How a direct `#note_<id>` issue or merge request link is described.

oneOf.description: Do not mention that the URL targets a comment.
Append `comment`, preserving the original plugin behavior.
Append the GitLab note ID, e.g. `comment 123`.
Append `comment by @user`; falls back to the note ID when the author cannot be fetched.
Append both the note ID and author; falls back to the note ID when the author cannot be fetched.

Instance.description: One GitLab instance the plugin can talk to.

token.description: Personal access token sent as `PRIVATE-TOKEN`. Usually a `${GITLAB_TOKEN}` reference with the `env_expansion` permission granted. Omit it for instances with public projects only.

instances.description: GitLab instances the plugin may query for real resource titles and project names. Without instances the plugin still works offline and produces short labels like `org/team/project!123`.
